messages:
maya: Deploybot alert — embeddings-service returning 502s in eu-west1, increased error rate ~3% since 09:12 UTC. Rolling back? Need expedited approval for hotfix. @sam @lee @nina

deploy-bot: [ALERT] service=embeddings env=prod region=eu-west1
```
status: degraded
linked_release: r2026-03-21-emb-v2.1.5
error_rate: 3.1%
recent_logs: "kvcache miss -> null -> panic in kv_write()"
```

sam: on it. is this a model binary/regression or infra? any repro? quick logs?

maya: logs point to kvcache invalidation after quantization patch — only triggered on long seqs. repro on canary runs.

lee: canary traffic shows 0.8% errors before deploy, spiked to 3.1% post-deploy. rolling back to r2026-03-20-emb-v2.1.4 should restore. we need ops signoff to skip full canary and fast-track.

nina: product impact: downstream reranking clients see latency spikes and dropped responses. Need a short release note update. also cc legal? low severity but visible.

zoe: ops lead here. we can approve expedited hotfix if QA + release notes are attached. @sam please include the short blurb.

sam: proposed action: pin traffic to r2026-03-20-emb-v2.1.4 in eu-west1, then push patched build to staging (v2.1.5-hotfix) for validation. rollback window 20m. anyone object?

nina: +1

maya: +1 from oncall. go ahead.

zoe: ops approve :white_check_mark:

sam: /deploy pin embeddings eu-west1 r2026-03-20-emb-v2.1.4 --reason "regression from quant patch causing kvcache invalidation" --expires 20m

deploy-bot: Command received: /deploy pin
Working: embeddings @ eu-west1 -> pinned to r2026-03-20-emb-v2.1.4
Start: 09:18 UTC
Status: pin in-progress

deploy-bot: Pin complete: routing updated. Traffic shift 100% to pinned release in 12s.

maya: monitoring... errors dropping

lee: metrics look good. error rate back to 0.9% in 2m.

sam: adding quick release note and changelog snippet:
```
Release note: Roll back embeddings service in eu-west1 due to kvcache invalidation after quantization patch. Workaround: pinned to previous stable (v2.1.4). Hotfix (v2.1.5-hotfix) in staging; will validate before re-deploy.
Changelog: Reverted quantization cache write for long sequences; added guard clause and unit test.
```

nina: LGTM, I'll update user-facing status page.

zoe: ops: expedited approval granted. reopen ticket for postmortem. :lock:

maya: thanks team. keeping watch for 30m.

sam: I'll kick off CI for v2.1.5-hotfix and tag for QA.

deploy-bot: CI triggered: build id=ci-789012, status=running

maya: closing loop: if green and QA + perf ok, we can schedule a staggered re-rollout. otherwise stick with pin.

lee: noted. end.
